segments.an5.103:1.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato mahācoro sandhimpi chindati, nillopampi harati, ekāgārikampi karoti, paripanthepi tiṭṭhati.
segments.an5.103:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro visamanissito ca hoti, gahananissito ca, balavanissito ca, bhogacāgī ca, ekacārī ca.
segments.an5.103:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro nadīviduggaṃ vā nissito hoti pabbatavisamaṃ vā.
segments.an5.103:2.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mahācoro visamanissito hoti.
segments.an5.103:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro tiṇagahanaṃ vā nissito hoti rukkhagahanaṃ vā rodhaṃ [gedhaṃ (sī.) a. ni.3.51] vā mahāvanasaṇḍaṃ vā.
segments.an5.103:3.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mahācoro gahananissito hoti.
segments.an5.103:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattānaṃ vā nissito hoti.
segments.an5.103:4.4: ‘sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati, ime me rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇissantī’ti.
segments.an5.103:4.5: Sace naṃ koci kiñci āha, tyassa rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇanti.
segments.an5.103:4.6: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mahācoro balavanissito hoti.
segments.an5.103:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro aḍḍho hoti mahaddhano mahābhogo.
segments.an5.103:5.4: ‘sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati, ito bhogena paṭisantharissāmī’ti.
segments.an5.103:5.5: Sace naṃ koci kiñci āha, tato bhogena paṭisantharati.
segments.an5.103:5.6: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mahācoro bhogacāgī hoti.
segments.an5.103:6.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro ekakova gahaṇāni [niggahaṇāni (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] kattā hoti.
segments.an5.103:6.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mahācoro ekacārī hoti.
segments.an5.103:7.1: “Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahaṅgehi samannāgato mahācoro sandhimpi chindati nillopampi harati ekāgārikampi karoti paripanthepi tiṭṭhati.
segments.an5.103:8.1: “Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato pāpabhikkhu khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.
segments.an5.103:8.3: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamanissito ca hoti, gahananissito ca, balavanissito ca, bhogacāgī ca, ekacārī ca.
segments.an5.103:9.2: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, visamena vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, visamena manokammena samannāgato hoti.
segments.an5.103:9.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamanissito hoti.
segments.an5.103:10.2: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu micchādiṭṭhiko hoti antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato.
segments.an5.103:10.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu gahananissito hoti.
segments.an5.103:11.2: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattānaṃ vā nissito hoti.
segments.an5.103:11.4: ‘sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati, ime me rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇissantī’ti.
segments.an5.103:11.5: Sace naṃ koci kiñci āha, tyassa rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇanti.
segments.an5.103:11.6: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu balavanissito hoti.
segments.an5.103:12.4: ‘sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati, ito lābhena paṭisantharissāmī’ti.
segments.an5.103:12.5: Sace naṃ koci kiñci āha, tato lābhena paṭisantharati.
segments.an5.103:12.6: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu bhogacāgī hoti.
segments.an5.103:13.2: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu ekakova paccantimesu janapadesu nivāsaṃ kappeti.
segments.an5.103:13.3: So tattha kulāni upasaṅkamanto lābhaṃ labhati.
segments.an5.103:13.4: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu ekacārī hoti.
segments.an5.103:14.1: “Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato pāpabhikkhu khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavatī”ti.

lines: Tatiye ito bhogena paṭisantharissāmīti ito mama sāpateyyato bhogaṃ gahetvā tena paṭisanthāraṃ karissāmi, tassa ca mama ca antaraṃ pidahissāmīti attho.
Antaggāhikāyāti sassataṃ vā ucchedaṃ vā gahetvā ṭhitāya.
Dutiye piṇḍapātādiatthāya upasaṅkamituṃ yuttaṭṭhānaṃ gocaro, vesiyā gocaro assāti vesiyāgocaro, mittasanthavavasena upasaṅkamitabbaṭṭhānanti attho.
Vesiyā nāma rūpūpajīviniyo, tā mittasanthavavasena na upasaṅkamitabbā samaṇabhāvassa antarāyakarattā, parisuddhāsayassapi garahāhetuto, tasmā dakkhiṇādānavasena satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ.
Te hi ussannakilesā avūpasantapariḷāhā lokāmisanissitakathābahulā, tasmā na upasaṅkamitabbā.
Aññamaññaṃ visabhāgavatthubhāvato santhavavasena upasaṅkamane katipāheneva brahmacariyantarāyo siyā, tasmā na upasaṅkamitabbā, gilānapucchanādivasena upasaṅkamane satokārinā bhavitabbaṃ.
